instruction.en: Create config/settings.json containing a JSON object with "debug" set to false and "workers" set to 4.
instruction.ar: أنشئ الملف config/settings.json وفيه كائن JSON تكون فيه قيمة "debug" هي false وقيمة "workers" هي 4.

checks.text:
import json
from pathlib import Path

data = json.loads(Path("config/settings.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert data == {"debug": False, "workers": 4}, data
print("settings ok")
